title: Shinonome Ena — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ena's Birthday
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... This dress is nice...
But it's a tad on the pretty side and I like it too much to wear for a day out shopping with friends.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I should just go with something closer to my usual...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, you awake?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, right. I forgot that I asked you to come wake me up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We ended up celebrating with Miku and the others yesterday, but I was trying to be careful about staying up too late and oversleeping...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks, Akito.
I'm wide awake.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You are? Once in a blue moon, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I can get up on my own if I try.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, quit asking me to be your alarm clock and start waking up on your own more.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's different. I still need an insurance policy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, what should I wear?
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is!
Ena, over here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Enaaa.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting.
But you're here pretty early. There's still like ten minutes until our meetup time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We weren't about to let the star of today's show wait. Also, we literally got here just now too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Anyway, ready...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena♪

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks, you guys!
We're gonna have so much fun shopping today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You know it!
As per your request, we'll be picking out a new summer outfit for you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, should we ask you what your budget is first? A full outfit may end up costing quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, but I should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I told my mom that I'd be shopping with my friends today, so she gave me some extra allowance money as my birthday present.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?!
Your family's okay with that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, some stuff here's gonna run you up a lot, so I guess we'll just have to price-check anything that looks good!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay.
We promise to do our best to find the perfect outfit for you, Ena♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks. I'm looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, how about this blouse?
It's chiffon and has some lace around the neck and shoulders, so it'll feel nice and cool.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And it's super cute!
You're right about it feeling nice and cool, Shizuku. Plus, it's not too revealing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! In terms of color choices... Besides white, you have black, pink and blue.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, look at that. Sax blue.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's a nice color. What do you think? I feel like black wouldn't really match the season, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: White and pink might look good on you, but you probably wouldn't want it to get dirty. Also, it wouldn't really suit your personality...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I probably wouldn't wear it much...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And what was that about my personality? I can pull off clean and pure just fine, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Alright, your highness.
How about this antique-looking blouse?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! That totally screams, “Pristine heiress!”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
W-Wait, Airi.
“Clean and pure” is one thing, but I'm not trying to look like a princess! Don't make things any harder for me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? I think it'd look very nice on you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're not here to pick out anything that'll look bad on you. I say give “clean and pure” princess Ena a shot! You can worry about purchasing it later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm all for that too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, if you're all willing to go that far.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Cool!
Next, we need a skirt that goes with that blouse...
Shopping Mall - Cafe

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, we walked around a ton...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We really did. It probably didn't help that we kept going between stores to compare everything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, this is good.
It's good exercise, right, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Speak for yourself. How much time do you spend indoors?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I am pretty tired. At the same time, I'm totally satisfied with our choices!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Airi.
It should be ready now, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it should be.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? What are you two talking about?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing.
We'll be powdering our noses for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uh, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What are they up to?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! You're in on this too, Mizuki?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No. What in the world are you talking about? I just can't believe how good this curry is.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... You're acting's terrible.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Welcome back, you two.
Wait, that's...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We asked this shop to prepare a mini birthday cake for you♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We know you usually have cheesecake at home, so we asked for a standard shortcake.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, it's not really a birthday party unless you have some cake, right♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No fair. You really did all this for me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, duh.
We're friends, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly. We're just glad that we get to celebrate with you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
So again, Ena, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I really appreciate it!
